text: Lesson 139.
Is that you, John?
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
zh_hant: 聽錄音，然後回答這個問題。

text: Which John Smith does Graham Turner
zh: 格雷厄姆·特纳认为他正在和哪个约翰·史密斯
zh_hant: 格雷厄姆·特納認為他正在和哪個約翰·史密斯

text: think he is talking to?
Is that you, John?
Yes, speaking.
Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
zh: 告诉玛丽，我们今晚吃饭会迟到。
zh_hant: 告訴瑪麗，我們今晚吃飯會遲到。

text: I'm afraid I don't understand.
Hasn't Mary told you?
She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.
zh: 她邀请我和夏洛特今晚去吃饭。
zh_hant: 她邀請我和夏洛特今晚去吃飯。

text: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock,
but the boss wants me to do some extra work.
I'll have to stay at the office.
I don't know when I'll finish.
zh: 我不知道什么时候能结束。
zh_hant: 我不知道什麼時候能結束。

text: Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know
zh: 哦，顺便说一下，我妻子想知道
zh_hant: 哦，順便說一下，我妻子想知道

text: if Mary needs any help.
I don't know what you're talking about.
That is John Smith, isn't it?
zh: 那是约翰·史密斯，不是吗？
zh_hant: 那是約翰·史密斯，不是嗎？

text: Yes, I'm John Smith.
You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?
zh: 你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吗？
zh_hant: 你是工程師約翰·史密斯，對嗎？

text: That's right.
You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?
zh: 你在海外工程公司工作，不是吗？
zh_hant: 你在海外工程公司工作，不是嗎？

text: No, I don't.
I'm John Smith the telephone engineer
zh: 我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯
zh_hant: 我是電話工程師約翰·史密斯

text: and I'm repairing your telephone line.
